caption:
Pakistan signs 13 mining deals at minerals forum!
According to Arab News, Pakistan signed 13 agreements and MoUs during the two-day Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum that ended in Islamabad on Friday. Forum president and OGDCL managing director Ahmed Hayat Lak said the deals cover mineral exploration, investment, geological surveys and work on existing mining licences. No combined value was shared. Agreements with Britain and Germany aim to boost cooperation with Pakistan's Geological Survey.
